cookies.title: Privacy & Cookie Preferences
cookies.summary: This site uses strictly necessary cookies and local storage for admin security, Redis-backed rate limiting, and viewing preferences.
cookies.essentialDesc: Encrypted session token (HttpOnly, Secure) used only to validate admin access and protect against brute-force in Redis.
cookies.prefDesc: Saves your language preference (ES/EN) in the browser so you don’t need to set it every visit.
cookies.thirdPartyDesc: No third-party cookies, tracking pixels, or external ad tools are used.
